name: Debug and refine trading strategy code
description: Users asked to debug, correct, or modify code for trading Expert Advisors, indicators, and Python signal generators to fix issues such as incorrect signals, calculation errors, compilation failures, and logic flaws. The requests focused on refining technical analysis logic, implementing specific risk management features like lot sizing and stop losses, and ensuring that buy and sell triggers executed as intended within various trading platforms.
